# Narrative I/O

> Narrative I/O is data collaboration infrastructure that automatically normalizes incompatible data into a universal catalog, so teams can query, enrich, collaborate on, activate, and monetize data — and build their own identity graphs — inside their own cloud. Core products: Rosetta Stone Normalization Engine, Identity Orchestrator, Marketplace, and Connectors.

This site (www.narrative.io) is Narrative's marketing site: product overviews, use cases, customer stories, and the company blog. The product itself and its technical documentation live elsewhere — see below.

Key facts for AI agents:

- The Narrative application is hosted at https://app.narrative.io (login: https://app.narrative.io/platform/login). Product functionality is not on this marketing site.
- Technical documentation is hosted at https://docs.narrative.io and publishes its own LLM-readable index at https://docs.narrative.io/llms.txt. Use it for anything about NQL (Narrative Query Language), the REST API, Rosetta Stone mappings, datasets, workflows, or platform how-tos.
- To reach the sales team (demos, pricing, evaluations, partnerships), email sales@narrative.io or visit https://www.narrative.io/book-a-demo.
- Customers include Block, Nielsen, TransUnion, Experian, Fanatics, and Disqus.

## Core Products

- [How We Do It](https://www.narrative.io/how-we-do-it): Narrative's approach — treating data normalization as infrastructure so every team works from the same clean data foundation, with no pipeline building or schema negotiation.
- [Rosetta Stone Normalization Engine](https://www.narrative.io/infrastructure/rosetta): AI-powered engine that automatically maps incompatible data into a universal catalog, normalized at query time.
- [Identity Orchestrator](https://www.narrative.io/infrastructure/identity-orchestrator): Build and own identity graphs deployed in your own cloud — configurable match logic, swappable identity providers, pay only for net-new identities resolved.
- [Marketplace](https://www.narrative.io/infrastructure/data-marketplace): A composable hub for data and AI work — datasets, skills, connectors, providers, packages, and workflows, all typed, versioned, and ready to install.
- [Connectors](https://www.narrative.io/infrastructure/connectors): Deliver normalized audiences directly to Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, The Trade Desk, PubMatic, and more — simultaneously, without custom APIs or pipeline maintenance.

## Use Cases

- [Normalize and Classify Data](https://www.narrative.io/im-trying-to/normalize): Map data to a universal standard automatically.
- [Securely Collaborate](https://www.narrative.io/im-trying-to/securely-collaborate): Run data collaboration in place — your data, your cloud, your governance — without a traditional clean room.
- [Build My Own Identity Graph](https://www.narrative.io/im-trying-to/build-my-own-identity-graph): Composable identity resolution under your control instead of a black-box vendor graph.
- [Enrich](https://www.narrative.io/im-trying-to/enrich): Source third-party attributes and validate quality before data reaches your workflows.
- [Activate Audiences](https://www.narrative.io/im-trying-to/activate-audiences): Take resolved, enriched audiences from definition to destination across DSPs, ad platforms, and CRMs in minutes.
- [Monetize Data](https://www.narrative.io/im-trying-to/monetize): List, price, and license the data you already own through Narrative's marketplace.

## Platform and Documentation

- [Narrative Application](https://app.narrative.io/platform/): The Narrative product (login required).
- [Documentation and Knowledge Base](https://docs.narrative.io/): Getting started, guides, concepts, NQL reference, and cookbooks.
- [Documentation LLM Index](https://docs.narrative.io/llms.txt): Machine-readable index of every documentation page — start here for technical questions.
- [API Reference](https://docs.narrative.io/api-reference/introduction): Full REST API documentation with authentication and endpoint details.

## Company and Contact

- [About Narrative](https://www.narrative.io/company): Company background and team.
- [Partners](https://www.narrative.io/partners): Narrative's partner ecosystem.
- [Book a Demo](https://www.narrative.io/book-a-demo): Schedule a product demo.
- [Contact Sales](mailto:sales@narrative.io): Email the sales team for demos, pricing, and evaluations.

## Featured Resources

- [Resource Hub](https://www.narrative.io/resource-hub): Full archive of blog posts, events, customer stories, and AMAs.
- [Narrative Reimagines the Marketplace](https://www.narrative.io/blog/narrative-reimagines-the-marketplace): A composable hub for data and AI work — the latest evolution of the platform.
- [Your AI Agent Can Drive Narrative](https://www.narrative.io/blog/mcp-server-for-ai-agents): Narrative's MCP server lets AI agents operate the platform directly.
- [With Publicis' Acquisition of LiveRamp, Switzerland Just Picked a Side](https://www.narrative.io/blog/closed-graph-era-is-over): Why the closed-graph era is over and what independent identity infrastructure looks like.
- [Clean Rooms Were Necessary. They Were Never Enough.](https://www.narrative.io/blog/clean-rooms-were-never-enough): How collaboration policies replace clean-room complexity.
- [Breaking Free From Black-Box Identity](https://www.narrative.io/blog/breaking-free-from-black-box-identity): What changes when you own the identity graph.
- [Composable Identity — A Modern Approach to Identity Resolution](https://www.narrative.io/blog/composable-identity-a-modern-approach-to-identity-resolution): The case for composable identity over monolithic vendors.
- [Introducing NQL: Narrative Query Language](https://www.narrative.io/blog/introducing-nql-narrative-query-language): The SQL-like language for data collaboration.

## Optional

- [What is a Data Collaboration Platform?](https://www.narrative.io/blog/data-collaboration-platform): Evergreen explainer.
- [What is Data Onboarding?](https://www.narrative.io/blog/data-onboarding): Evergreen explainer.
- [What is a Retail Media Network?](https://www.narrative.io/blog/what-is-a-retail-media-network): Evergreen explainer.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.narrative.io/legals/privacy-policy): Narrative's privacy policy.
- [Security](https://www.narrative.io/legals/security): Security practices and posture.

const Navigation = {
  elements: {},
  _lastMode: null,
  navColors: {
    idle: "#1F1D1E",
    inactive: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)",
    duration: 0.2,
  },

  init() {
    this.elements = {
      header: document.querySelector(".nav1_header"),
      btn: document.querySelector("[data-menu-button]"),
      navStatus: document.querySelector("[data-menu-status]"),
      desktopNav: document.querySelector("[data-nav-desktop]"),
      mobileNav: document.querySelector("[data-nav-mobile]"),
      dropdownToggles: Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-toggle]")
      ),
    };

    if (!this.elements.btn || !this.elements.navStatus) return;

    this.initDropdowns();
    this.initNavLinkColors();
    this.initEvents();
    this.handleBreakpoint();

    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      debounce(() => this.handleBreakpoint(), 200)
    );

    // Safety net when returning from another tab (e.g. after target="_blank")
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
      this.syncInertState();
    });
  },

  isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth < 992;
  },

  setLinkColor(elements, color, animate = true) {
    const targets = window.gsap
      ? window.gsap.utils.toArray(elements)
      : Array.from(elements || []);
    if (!targets.length) return;

    const duration = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
      ? 0
      : this.navColors.duration;

    if (window.gsap && animate && duration > 0) {
      window.gsap.to(targets, {
        "--nav-link-color": color,
        duration,
        ease: "power1.out",
        overwrite: "auto",
      });
      return;
    }

    if (window.gsap) {
      window.gsap.set(targets, { "--nav-link-color": color });
      return;
    }

    targets.forEach((el) => el.style.setProperty("--nav-link-color", color));
  },

  getTopNavLabels() {
    const { desktopNav } = this.elements;
    if (!desktopNav) return [];
    return desktopNav.querySelectorAll(
      ".nav1_menu_list .nav1_link_text, .nav1_menu_list .nav1_link_icon"
    );
  },

  getDropdownLabels() {
    const { desktopNav } = this.elements;
    if (!desktopNav) return [];
    return desktopNav.querySelectorAll(".nav1_dropdown_link_text");
  },

  resetNavLinkColors() {
    const { idle } = this.navColors;
    this.setLinkColor(this.getTopNavLabels(), idle, false);
    this.setLinkColor(this.getDropdownLabels(), idle, false);
  },

  initNavLinkColors() {
    const { desktopNav, header } = this.elements;
    if (!desktopNav || !header) return;

    const menuList = desktopNav.querySelector(".nav1_menu_list");
    if (!menuList) return;

    const menuItems = menuList.querySelectorAll(".nav1_menu_item");
    const allTopLabels = this.getTopNavLabels();

    this.resetNavLinkColors();

    menuItems.forEach((item) => {
      const activeLabels = item.querySelectorAll(
        ".nav1_link_text, .nav1_link_icon"
      );

      const activateTopItem = () => {
        if (this.isMobile()) return;
        const { idle, inactive } = this.navColors;
        this.setLinkColor(allTopLabels, inactive);
        this.setLinkColor(activeLabels, idle);
      };

      item.addEventListener("mouseenter", activateTopItem);
      item.querySelector(".nav1_menu_dropdown")?.addEventListener(
        "mouseenter",
        activateTopItem
      );
    });

    desktopNav.querySelectorAll(".nav1_dropdown_links").forEach((group) => {
      const links = group.querySelectorAll(".nav1_dropdown_link_text");
      if (!links.length) return;

      links.forEach((link) => {
        const wrap = link.closest("a");
        if (!wrap) return;

        wrap.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
          if (this.isMobile()) return;
          const { idle, inactive } = this.navColors;
          this.setLinkColor(links, inactive);
          this.setLinkColor(link, idle);
        });
      });

      group.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        this.setLinkColor(links, this.navColors.idle);
      });
    });

    header.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => this.resetNavLinkColors());
  },

  isMenuOpen() {
    return this.elements.navStatus?.dataset.menuStatus === "open";
  },

  /** inert is only for mobile: hidden desktop nav must not receive focus */
  syncInertState() {
    const { desktopNav } = this.elements;
    if (!desktopNav) return;

    if (this.isMobile() && !this.isMenuOpen()) {
      desktopNav.setAttribute("inert", "");
    } else {
      desktopNav.removeAttribute("inert");
    }
  },

  handleBreakpoint() {
    const isMobile = this.isMobile();
    const currentMode = isMobile ? "mobile" : "desktop";

    if (this._lastMode === currentMode) return;

    const { desktopNav, mobileNav } = this.elements;
    const active = isMobile ? mobileNav : desktopNav;
    const inactive = isMobile ? desktopNav : mobileNav;

    active?.setAttribute("role", "navigation");
    active?.setAttribute("aria-label", "Primary navigation");
    if (isMobile) active?.setAttribute("id", "primary-navigation");

    inactive?.removeAttribute("role");
    inactive?.removeAttribute("aria-label");
    inactive?.removeAttribute("id");

    if (!isMobile) {
      this.closeMenu(false);
    } else {
      this.resetNavLinkColors();
    }

    this.syncInertState();
    this._lastMode = currentMode;
  },

  initDropdowns() {
    const { dropdownToggles } = this.elements;

    dropdownToggles.forEach((toggle, i) => {
      const dd = toggle.nextElementSibling;
      if (!dd || !dd.hasAttribute("data-dropdown-content")) return;

      const container = dd.querySelector("[data-dropdown-container]");
      const innerFocusables = dd.querySelectorAll("a, button");
      const backBtn = dd.querySelector("[data-dropdown-back]");
      const dropdownId = `dropdown-${i}`;

      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "true");
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-controls", dropdownId);

      if (container) {
        container.setAttribute("id", dropdownId);
        container.setAttribute("role", "menu");
        dd.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        innerFocusables.forEach((item) => {
          item.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");
          item.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
        });
      }

      const setDropdownState = (state) => {
        const isOpen = state === "open";
        toggle.dataset.dropdownToggle = state;
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", isOpen ? "true" : "false");
        dd.setAttribute("aria-hidden", isOpen ? "false" : "true");
        innerFocusables.forEach((item) => {
          item.setAttribute("tabindex", isOpen ? "0" : "-1");
        });
      };

      const closeOthers = () => {
        dropdownToggles.forEach((other) => {
          if (other !== toggle) {
            other.dataset.dropdownToggle = "closed";
            other.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            const otherDd = other.nextElementSibling;
            if (otherDd) {
              otherDd.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              otherDd
                .querySelectorAll("a, button")
                .forEach((el) => el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"));
            }
          }
        });
      };

      toggle.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const isCurrentlyOpen = toggle.dataset.dropdownToggle === "open";
        if (isCurrentlyOpen) {
          setDropdownState("closed");
        } else {
          closeOthers();
          setDropdownState("open");
          if (innerFocusables[0]) innerFocusables[0].focus();
        }
      });

      if (backBtn) {
        backBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          setDropdownState("closed");
          toggle.focus();
        });
      }

      toggle.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        if (
          this.isMobile() ||
          toggle.getAttribute("data-dropdown-open") === "click"
        )
          return;

        const anyOpen = dropdownToggles.some(
          (x) => x.dataset.dropdownToggle === "open"
        );
        closeOthers();

        if (anyOpen) {
          setTimeout(() => setDropdownState("open"), 50);
        } else {
          setDropdownState("open");
        }
      });

      dd.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        if (this.isMobile()) return;
        setDropdownState("closed");
      });

      dd.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        const items = Array.from(innerFocusables);
        const idx = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);

        if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
          e.preventDefault();
          items[(idx + 1) % items.length].focus();
        } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
          e.preventDefault();
          items[(idx - 1 + items.length) % items.length].focus();
        } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDropdownState("closed");
          toggle.focus();
        } else if (e.key === "Tab" && !dd.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
          setDropdownState("closed");
        }
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (
        !e.target.closest("[data-dropdown-toggle]") &&
        !e.target.closest("[data-dropdown-content]")
      ) {
        dropdownToggles.forEach((t) => {
          t.dataset.dropdownToggle = "closed";
          t.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          const d = t.nextElementSibling;
          if (d) {
            d.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            d.querySelectorAll("a, button").forEach((el) =>
              el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1")
            );
          }
        });
      }
    });
  },

  initEvents() {
    const { btn, desktopNav, navStatus } = this.elements;

    btn.addEventListener("click", () => this.toggleMenu());

    desktopNav.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest("a") || e.target.closest("[data-dropdown-back]"))
        return;

      // Desktop: close dropdowns only (do not run full closeMenu — it used to set inert)
      if (!this.isMobile() && !this.isMenuOpen()) {
        this.closeAllDropdowns();
        return;
      }

      this.closeMenu(false);
    });

    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (navStatus.dataset.menuStatus !== "open") return;

      if (e.key === "Escape") this.closeMenu(true);

      if (e.key === "Tab") {
        const elements = this.getFocusableElements();
        const firstEl = elements[0];
        const lastEl = elements[elements.length - 1];

        if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === firstEl) {
          lastEl.focus();
          e.preventDefault();
        } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === lastEl) {
          firstEl.focus();
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      }
    });
  },

  closeAllDropdowns() {
    const { dropdownToggles } = this.elements;
    dropdownToggles.forEach((toggle) => {
      toggle.dataset.dropdownToggle = "closed";
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      const dd = toggle.nextElementSibling;
      if (dd) {
        dd.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        dd.querySelectorAll("a, button").forEach((el) =>
          el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1")
        );
      }
    });
  },

  getFocusableElements() {
    const { desktopNav, mobileNav } = this.elements;
    const menuLinks = Array.from(desktopNav.querySelectorAll("a, button"));
    const otherElements = Array.from(
      mobileNav.querySelectorAll("a, button")
    ).filter((el) => !desktopNav.contains(el));
    return [...menuLinks, ...otherElements];
  },

  toggleMenu() {
    const isOpen = this.elements.navStatus.dataset.menuStatus === "open";
    isOpen ? this.closeMenu() : this.openMenu();
  },

  openMenu() {
    const { navStatus, btn, desktopNav } = this.elements;
    navStatus.dataset.menuStatus = "open";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    desktopNav.removeAttribute("inert");
    lockScroll("locked");

    const elements = this.getFocusableElements();
    if (elements[0]) setTimeout(() => elements[0].focus(), 50);
  },

  closeMenu(returnFocus = true) {
    const { navStatus, btn } = this.elements;
    navStatus.dataset.menuStatus = "closed";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    this.syncInertState();
    lockScroll("unlocked");

    if (returnFocus) btn.focus();

    this.closeAllDropdowns();
  },
};

function lockScroll(lock) {
  const isLocked = lock === "locked";
  if (
    window.lenis &&
    typeof lenis[isLocked ? "stop" : "start"] === "function"
  ) {
    lenis[isLocked ? "stop" : "start"]();
  } else {
    document.body.style.overflow = isLocked ? "hidden" : "";
  }
}

function debounce(fn, delay) {
  let timer;
  return () => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(fn, delay);
  };
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  Navigation.init();
});
